status: The committed generic Field Finance History decision is mounted into a real native Finance journal detail/workspace read. The new private routes serve Field payment/reversal journals that the manual/opening detail reader rejects, while ordinary manual journals are not admitted by the generic route. The native journal page reader selects the generic route only after a bounded native 404, never after denial or transport failure. No owner or workflow is promoted.
